scientific.integrity: The primary source defining the quantities and posing the open problem was materially inspected, together with an open Euclidean companion source. The proof independently computes the relative simplex unit ball, its polar, the extremal cross-polytope determinant, and the circumscribed-parallelotope dual. Candidate-specific searches covered the principal geometric and determinant aliases.
limitations: The result evaluates Lángi's four point-reflection quantities on simplices but does not solve their global extremal problem over all convex bodies.
The mass* value is exact in terms of the zero-one maximal determinant \(D_n\), which has no known closed formula in all dimensions.
The bundled enumeration checks dimensions \(2,3,4\) only; the all-dimensional proof uses total unimodularity, polarity, and the exact sign-chamber integral.
Equivalent later-literature notation remains a residual historical originality risk.

title: Exact relative point-reflection volumes of simplices
